title: Sticky header
summary: position: sticky with top: 0 inside a scrolling container.
explanation: A sticky element behaves like a normal one until its scroll container scrolls it to the given offset, then it sticks there.
It needs an offset (top: 0) and it only sticks within its parent, so the parent must be taller than it.
If an ancestor between it and the scroller has overflow: hidden, sticky silently stops working.
